basic_info.description: Opportunity knocks in Silver Terrace! This 3-bedroom, 2-baths fixer-upper at 41 Apollo Street offers incredible potential in one of San Francisco’s fastest-growing neighborhoods. With approximately 1,087 sq ft of living space on a 2,491 sq ft lot, the home is ready for renovation and customization. Located on a quiet residential street near parks, public transit, and Bayview’s emerging dining scene, it’s ideal for buyers or investors looking to add value. Solid bones and classic charm—bring your vision and make it yours. Buyer to verify all details including square footage, room count, permits, and property history.
